integrity: Proof is self-contained with five exact affine branch formulas and invariant-area derivation; included exact-rational checker supports, not replaces, the universal claim. Prior full periodicity with unbounded period is explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: The square–rhombus Example 2.29 regular phase space only; no claims for vertex-collision trajectories or other polygons. The exact probability law uses invariant symplectic area rather than equal chart weighting. Priority is subject to unindexed literature.
title: Exact dyadic period spectrum and symplectic-area law for a fully periodic polygon pair
